While in <stasis/>Stasis Mode with Stasis Overcharge active:
Precision Hits and Kills trigger a Stasis Explosion, consuming 34% Overcharge energy and dealing <pve 115 /> <pvp [?] /> damage in a ? meter radius. The explosion creates two <stasis/>Medium Stasis Crystals that spawn 4 meters away on either side of the target at a 45 degree angle.
